records.jp: んー……風が気持ちいい！
records.en_original: Ah, the breeze feels good!
records.en: Ah, the breeze feels good!

records.jp: ここって、静かで落ち着くよね
records.en_original: It's nice and quiet here.
records.en: It's nice and quiet here.

records.jp: いくら待っても、電車が来ないっていうのが<CR>ちょっと変な感じだけどね
records.en_original: It's weird being in a station knowing that a train is never gonna come.
records.en: It's weird being in a station knowing that a<CR>train is never gonna come.

records.jp: あはは、わかるー
records.en_original: Ahaha, totally.
records.en: Ahaha, totally.

records.jp: でもさ……ここから乗る電車なら<CR>どこにでも連れて行ってくれそうだよね<CR>
records.en_original: Still... A train from here seems like it could take us anywhere.
records.en: Still... A train from here seems<CR>like it could take us anywhere.<CR>

records.jp: 異世界とか？
records.en_original: Like to another world?
records.en: Like to another world?

records.jp: 異世界？　転生しちゃうあれ？
records.en_original: Another world? Like one of those shows where people get transported to a fantasy world?
records.en: Another world? The kind where you get reincarnated?

records.jp: そうそう！　剣と魔法とエルフとゴブリンが<CR>存在しちゃう、あの世界だよ！
records.en_original: Exactly! The ones with swords and sorcery and elves and goblins!
records.en: Exactly! The ones with swords and sorcery<CR>and elves and goblins!

records.jp: 勇者に選ばれて、チート級の魔法で<CR>敵をバッタバッタ倒しちゃう感じでさー！
records.en_original: And the hero turns out to be the chosen one and gets to wail on bad guys with magic that's way overpowered!
records.en: And the hero turns out to be the chosen one and<CR>gets to wail on bad guys with magic that's way overpowered!

records.jp: ……ふふ！
records.en_original: ...Hehe!
records.en: ...Hehe!

records.jp: え、何？
records.en_original: Huh? What's so funny?
records.en: Huh? What's so funny?

records.jp: エルフとゴブリンはいないけど、今の状況って<CR>かなり異世界だと思わない？
records.en_original: We may not have elves or goblins, but our situation is pretty similar, don't you think?
records.en: We may not have elves or goblins, but our situation is<CR>pretty similar, don't you think?

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、リーダーに選ばれて<CR>バッタバッタと敵を倒してるよ？
records.en_original: You're our chosen leader and now you're wailing on bad guys!
records.en: Ao-chan, you have been chosen as leader and you<CR>are mowing down enemies left and right, you know?

records.jp: そう言われると……そうなのかな？
records.en_original: Now that you mention it... That's kinda true.
records.en: Now that you mention it... That's kinda true.

records.jp: でも、私は勇者って感じじゃないし<CR>チート能力も備わってないからなあ……
records.en_original: But I don't feel like a hero... And I don't have any crazy strong magic...
records.en: But I don't feel like a hero... And<CR>I don't have any crazy strong magic...

records.jp: あ、でも！　美少女達に囲まれてる！<CR>そう考えると、確かにここも異世界……？
records.en_original: Oh, but I am surrounded by a whole bunch of lovely ladies, just like in my anime!
records.en: Oh, but I am surrounded by a whole bunch<CR>of lovely ladies, just like in my anime!

records.jp: 不思議の国とか？
records.en_original: Like to wonderland?
records.en: Like to wonderland?

records.jp: あ、いいねー！　メルヘンチックな<CR>可愛い世界にいってみたいかも！
records.en_original: Oh, that would be amazing! I wish I could go to a cute fairy-tale world like that.
records.en: Oh, that would be amazing! I wish I could<CR>go to a cute fairy-tale world like that.

records.jp: 話せる動物さんたちと、お茶会したりね
records.en_original: We could have a tea party with a bunch of talking animals!
records.en: We could have a tea party with a bunch of talking animals!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんは、絶対エプロンドレスが<CR>似合うと思うんだよね
records.en_original: You'd look adorable in a dress with a pinafore.
records.en: I think an apron dress would definitely<CR>suit you, Hiori-san.

records.jp: えっ、エプロンドレス？
records.en_original: A pinafore...?
records.en: A pinafore...?

records.jp: 膝の上にリスとか小鳥とか乗せてさ、<CR>お花畑の真ん中で、歌って欲しいなー
records.en_original: I could totally see you singing in a field of flowers, tiny birds and forest creatures gathering around to join in...
records.en: I could totally see you singing in a field of flowers, tiny<CR>birds and forest creatures gathering around to join in...

records.jp: 私は、それを隣で聞いていたい。<CR>はあ……想像したら、すごくいい……
records.en_original: And I'd be right beside you listening! Yeah, that's not a bad idea...
records.en: And I'd be right beside you listening!<CR>Yeah, that's not a bad idea...

records.jp: あははっ。<CR>愛央ちゃんの想像力って、いっつも面白いよね
records.en_original: Ahaha! Your imagination is as incredible as ever!
records.en: Ahaha! Your<CR>imagination is always so fun, Ao-chan.

records.jp: いやー、オタクなだけですよー
records.en_original: I'm just a dork, that's all.
records.en: No, I am simply an otaku.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんは、どこに行きたいとかある？
records.en_original: How about you, Hiori? Where would you like to go?
records.en: How about you, Hiori-san? Where would you like to go?

records.jp: ん～……今は、とくにないかなぁ
records.en_original: Hmm... Nowhere in particular.
records.en: Hmm... Nowhere in particular.

records.jp: みんなと一緒に、元の世界に帰りたいって<CR>そればっかり、考えてるから
records.en_original: All I can think about is returning to the home to our world with everyone.
records.en: All I can think about<CR>is returning to our original world with everyone.

records.jp: そうだね。元の世界に行けたら、<CR>それが一番良いんだけど……
records.en_original: Right. If we had a choice, home would be nice...
records.en: Right. If we had a choice,<CR>home would be nice...

records.jp: でもさ。みんなで元の世界に戻れたら<CR>どこか遊びに行ったりしたいよね
records.en_original: But I really want to go somewhere with everyone when we get back.
records.en: But I really want to go somewhere<CR>with everyone when we get back.

records.jp: それ、めちゃくちゃいいじゃん！<CR>行きたい！！
records.en_original: That would be great! Good idea!
records.en: That would be great!<CR>Good idea!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、どこに行きたい？
records.en_original: Any ideas for where we should go?
records.en: Ao-chan, where do you want to go?

records.jp: やっぱ、遊園地っしょ！
records.en_original: An amusement park, for sure!
records.en: An amusement park, for sure!

records.jp: 遊園地、行きたいね！<CR>私、ジェットコースター乗りたいなあ
records.en_original: That would be amazing! I love rollercoasters.
records.en: That would be<CR>amazing! I love rollercoasters.

records.jp: おお、陽桜莉さん。いけるタイプ？
records.en_original: Ooh, you like those kind of rides?
records.en: Ooh, Hiori-san. Are you the type who can handle those?

records.jp: いけるタイプ！<CR>絶叫系、大好きだよ！
records.en_original: I love them! The scarier, the better!
records.en: I love them! The<CR>scarier, the better!

records.jp: んじゃ、遊園地行ったら絶叫系は制覇だ！
records.en_original: Okay! When we go, we'll make sure to hit every coaster they have!
records.en: Okay! When we go, we'll make sure to hit every coaster they have!

records.jp: みんなで、ショッピングとかどうかな？
records.en_original: We should all go shopping!
records.en: We should all go shopping!

records.jp: 楽しそうだけど……みんな好みが<CR>バラバラだから、一緒に回るの大変そう
records.en_original: That sounds fun, but I think everyone's tastes are pretty different... We'd probably have to hit every store imaginable.
records.en: That sounds fun, but I think everyone's tastes are pretty<CR>different... We'd probably have to hit every store imaginable.

records.jp: あー、たしかに。<CR>……んじゃ、食べ歩きは？
records.en_original: That's true... How about just grabbing some food and strolling around town?
records.en: That's true... How about just<CR>grabbing some food and strolling around town?

records.jp: あ、いいね。<CR>クレープとか、タピオカとか食べたい！
records.en_original: Good idea! We could get crepes and bubble tea!
records.en: Good idea!<CR>We could get crepes and bubble tea!

records.jp: みんながいれば、色んな味もシェアできるし<CR>絶対楽しいって！
records.en_original: We can all get different flavors and share with everyone!
records.en: We can all get different flavors and share<CR>with everyone!

records.jp: それが、現実になるように<CR>ここで頑張らないとだね
records.en_original: We'll have to work our hardest and make sure we get to do all that.
records.en: We'll have to work our hardest and<CR>make sure we get to do all that.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: でもね、愛央ちゃん、私……
records.en_original: But Ao, I...
records.en: But Ao-chan, I...

records.jp: どんな世界にいたって、<CR>どんな場所にいたって……
records.en_original: No matter what world we're in, or where we are...
records.en: No matter what world we're<CR>in, or where we are...

records.jp: みんなや、愛央ちゃんがいたら、<CR>きっと、毎日楽しく過ごせると思う
records.en_original: As long as I'm with you and the others, I'll be happy.
records.en: If you and everyone else are there,<CR>Ao-chan, I'm sure every day will be fun.

records.jp: 元の世界に戻りたいって気持ちと同じぐらい、<CR>みんなと一緒にいたいとも思ってるんだ
records.en_original: I know we all want to go home, but being with everybody is just as important to me.
records.en: I know we all want to go home, but being with<CR>everybody is just as important to me.

records.jp: その気持ち、私も分かるよ。
records.en_original: I know how you feel.
records.en: I know how you feel.

records.jp: 元の世界に戻っても、みんなや陽桜莉さんと<CR>一緒に、いられたらいいなって思う
records.en_original: I hope we all can stay together when we get home.
records.en: I hope I can stay with everyone and Hiori-san<CR>even after we return to the real world.

records.jp: これから先、何が起こるかわかんないけど、<CR>みんなとの時間や、絆だけは失くしたくない
records.en_original: We may not know what will happen in the future, but I don't want to lose the time and memories we had together.
records.en: We do not know what will happen from here on,<CR>but I do not want to lose my time or bonds with everyone.

records.jp: ……大丈夫。一度失くした記憶だって<CR>取り戻せたんだもん！
records.en_original: It'll be fine. I mean, we all got our memories back, right?
records.en: It'll be fine. I mean, we all got our<CR>memories back, right?

records.jp: 私達の絆だって、消えたりしない。<CR>これからもずっとずっと、お友達だよ！
records.en_original: The bonds we have with each other won't just disappear. We're friends, now and forever!
records.en: The bonds we have with each other won't<CR>just disappear. We're friends, now and forever!

records.jp: うん、そうだよね！
records.en_original: Yeah, you're right!
records.en: Yeah, you're right!

records.jp: だけど、ずっとここにはいられないよ
records.en_original: We can't stay here forever.
records.en: We can't stay here forever.

records.jp: うん、わかってる。
records.en_original: Yeah, I know.
records.en: Yeah, I know.

records.jp: だからこそ、こうして愛央ちゃんと<CR>過ごせる時間も、大切にしたいなって思うんだ
records.en_original: That's why I want to treasure the time we spend here together.
records.en: That is exactly why I want to treasure<CR>the time I can spend with Ao-chan like this.

records.jp: ……何があっても、後悔しないように
records.en_original: No matter what happens, I don't want to have any regrets.
records.en: No matter what happens, I don't want to have any regrets.

records.jp: そうだね……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...
